about: W1-37 in-app browser check (Claude desktop Browser pane, Chromium) of the LIVE tree on Adam's running Flask server, 02-Oct-2026 02:54 UTC. Page: scratch/W1-37/palette_check.html (real CSS index, real Plan Annotations toolbar with its real imports, mounted into a #root like the 3D tab's). Viewport emulated at 1600 x 900 (the pane was hidden). Script-made events: the browser refuses its own mixer (showPicker) without a user gesture, so the native mixer itself was not opened or seen. Console: only '[ValeVision3D ColourPalette] 13 colour(s) in 1 palette(s).'; no error.
checks: PASS the CSS index imports the palette stylesheet (it is in the page's @import chain, after Boot)
PASS the palette config loaded and the palette is available
PASS the toolbar has its dimension colour field
PASS a click on the dimension colour is taken from the browser and opens the palette
PASS the palette is styled by its sheet: fixed to the window over everything (z 1300), white, ringed in the panels' grey (declared 1px solid rgb(204, 211, 216))
PASS titled with the Vale name, Monochrome (10) then Dimensions (3) swatches of 22 px
PASS it sits inside the window, clear of the field, with the proxy strip (the mixer's hanging point) above it; proxy opacity 0, pointer-events none
PASS the swatch for the field's colour is ringed (the next dimension's default #323232 is not a palette colour: none ringed, readout 'custom colour')
PASS a swatch pick puts Existing in the field: input, then change (#000096)
PASS and the field lets go of the focus; the palette and the proxy are gone
PASS a disabled field: the click is not taken and no palette opens

geometry.reading: The toolbar sits under the header (top 78 px), so there is no room above the field for the mixer (250 px) and the palette; the stack goes to the field's LEFT: the mixer would hang from y 8 to 258 and the palette sits at 262 to 408, 4 px under it. Whether Chrome's real mixer is 232 x 250 on Adam's screen is his to see (risk: the browser's own mixer cannot be seen headless).
